pages.title: Soccer Orbit
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Kick a football into orbit in Soccer Orbit. Time the power gauge to send it farther through space and collect money from the flight. Improve power, speed and bounce before trying to beat the previous distance.

pages.title: Cosmic Ace
pages.creator: SandieGames
pages.description: Pilot a combat jet through escalating invasions in Cosmic Ace. Aim with the mouse, maneuver with the keyboard and burn nitro when you need more speed. Collect nanocores for upgrades during a run and unlock aircraft or weapons in the hangar.

pages.title: Circles
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Trace the requested sequence of colored circles in Circles. Read the pattern before selecting the pieces and keep the chain moving quickly. Use the bonus boosters at the bottom to trigger stronger reactions and build a higher score.

pages.title: ASMR Beauty Clinic
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat cartoon clients in ASMR Beauty Clinic. Work on damaged nails, clean teeth or care for skin using the tools provided for each appointment. Finish with decorative details such as nail art once the treatment steps are complete.

pages.title: Stick Master Teleport
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Use knives to travel between targets in Stick Master Teleport. Aim, release the blade and teleport toward an enemy to strike. Jump onto walls and choose an approach that lets the ninja clear the group before it can respond.

pages.title: Witchy and the Puzzle Adventures
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a witch toward lost kittens in Witchy and the Puzzle Adventures. Pick up special cards and use nearby objects to open the route. Redirect lasers or destroy barriers when needed to get through the forest's puzzles.

pages.title: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue!
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Send water into a trapped animal's chamber in Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue! Examine the partitions before removing one and create a safe channel to the fish. Use the order of the pins to keep hazards away while filling its space.

pages.title: STALKER-Strike
pages.creator: Y-rec
pages.description: Fight as a stalker or special-forces soldier in STALKER-Strike. Enter online firefights where anomalies and traps complicate the map. Level up through battles and watch environmental hazards as closely as the opposing players.

pages.title: BFFs Luxury Loungewear
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create sleepover looks in BFFs Luxury Loungewear. Dress Riri, Elsa, Polka and Bonnie from wardrobes of cotton, knitted, velour and silk pieces. Add accessories that coordinate with each friend's chosen nightwear.

pages.title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Organize shelves in Good Sort Master: Triple Match. Drag identical goods together in groups of three to clear them and make room for more. Look behind the front items as you tidy the remaining stock.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Cookware
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Clear the kitchen in Mahjong Connect Cookware. Pair identical utensils using paths that turn no more than twice around other pieces. Remove matches that create new channels until no cookware remains on the board.

pages.title: Single Stroke Line Draw
pages.creator: Magic Game Studio
pages.description: Draw a continuous path through a figure in Single Stroke Line Draw. Connect all points without retracing a route or lifting your stroke. Plan around junctions before beginning the more complicated patterns.

pages.title: Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game
pages.creator: boooogiegames
pages.description: Drop animals into a shared container in Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game. Position the dropper so equal creatures collide and combine into the next type. Keep making room for larger animals as you build the collection.

pages.title: Underwater Survival Deep Dive
pages.creator: Craft Game World RA
pages.description: Explore an alien ocean in Underwater Survival Deep Dive. Move between the surface and the depths, use a flashlight to inspect dark areas and carry a stun gun for dangerous encounters. Treat the ship as your refuge while investigating the open water.

pages.title: Spot&Differs
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Find the changes between paired pictures in Spot&Differs. Scan corresponding areas and select the altered details before the timer ends. Complete the required set of five or more differences to open another scene.

pages.title: Jump Ball Classic
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Keep a ball clear of hazards in Jump Ball Classic. Tap to jump and move into a safe space before an obstacle reaches it. Stay focused on the next landing because a collision immediately ends the attempt.

pages.title: Playground- Parkour
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Take a ragdoll through movement and combat challenges in Playground- Parkour. Run, jump and fight enemies as the floppy character collides with the scenery. Train and upgrade the hero to unlock more levels.

pages.title: MR RACER - Car Racing
pages.creator: ChennaiGames Studio Private Limited
pages.description: Drive supercars through traffic in MR RACER - Car Racing. Accelerate with W or the up arrow and steer through clear lanes without hitting other vehicles. Learn when to hold speed and when the crowded road needs a slower approach.

pages.title: Lighthouse Havoc
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Search a demon-infested island for your friends in Lighthouse Havoc. Use the weapons you find to get past attackers and rescue survivors captured around the lighthouse. Guide the group back toward safety while watching the routes between encounters.

pages.title: Super Snappy Tower
pages.creator: Gamebop
pages.description: Build a tall, stable structure in Super Snappy Tower. Stack the pieces so their weight supports the next layer instead of tipping it over. Compete with friends and try to climb the weekly tournament rankings.

pages.title: Chibi Unicorn Games for Girls
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Create a small fantasy animal in Chibi Unicorn Games for Girls. Begin with its coat, then choose colors and decorative details for the pony. Combine the avatar options until the unicorn has the look you want.

pages.title: BFF Dress Up - Girl Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Visit the mall with friends in BFF Dress Up - Girl Games. Browse clothes and jewelry, try combinations on the characters and finish their makeovers. Coordinate each outfit before moving on to another friend.

pages.title: Treehouses Maker
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Clear wooden squares to construct homes in Treehouses Maker. Put three matching pieces into the five-slot tray to remove them and reveal the next layer. Keep enough space available to finish the arrangement and collect its building materials.

pages.title: Bricks Crusher Breaker Ball
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Aim streams of shots through numbered blocks in Bricks Crusher Breaker Ball. Find angles that keep the balls bouncing into several targets, then use special balls or blocks when they help. Clear each formation before moving to another level.

pages.title: Trial 2 Player Moto Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race bikes over ramps, crates and large cylinders in Trial 2 Player Moto Racing. Control the balance on landings and use nitro to gain ground on clear stretches. Play alone or share the obstacle course with a second rider.

pages.title: Bff Trendy K-Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Explore Korean-inspired outfits in Bff Trendy K-Fashion. Help friends choose garments for their fashion challenge and combine the pieces into separate looks. Finish with accessories that suit each outfit before comparing the group.

pages.title: Clear the Island
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description: Cut through vegetation in Clear the Island. Hold to move while watching for obstacles that the cutter cannot handle. Use temporary size increases to destroy larger objects and clear more of the route.

pages.title: Hyper Racing Madness
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Race computer-controlled drivers in Hyper Racing Madness. Start with an accessible sports car and work toward more powerful models as you complete events. Learn the bends of the three-dimensional circuits to challenge for the lead.

pages.title: Ninja Slash : Shuriken Masters
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Aim a throwing star at approaching blocks in Ninja Slash : Shuriken Masters. Hold to adjust the direction and release when the trajectory looks useful. Break the targets and collect new shuriken as you keep playing.

pages.title: Basketball Beans
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pass, steal and shoot in Basketball Beans. Guide your team into position for a three-pointer or a dunk while keeping opponents from taking possession. Spend tournament rewards on more basketballs and new team uniforms.

pages.title: The Great Zombie Warzone
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Lead human defenders against an undead army in The Great Zombie Warzone. Choose your strategy and strengthen the force before another assault arrives. Keep the attackers away from the people you are protecting.

pages.title: Alphabet Game
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Practice letters and related objects in Alphabet Game. Look at the current prompt and select the matching response with the mouse or touch controls. Work through the activities to connect alphabet knowledge with familiar pictures.

pages.title: Ski Rush 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Spread or bring together a skier's legs in Ski Rush 3D. Drag left and right to choose a path that fits the obstacles ahead. Keep adjusting until both skis reach the destination safely.

pages.title: Bowling Hero Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Choose a character and aim down the lane in Bowling Hero Multiplayer. Set your position, throwing power and direction to hit as many pins as possible. Share the device with friends or challenge players online.

pages.title: MatchCraft Match Three
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Dig through block-themed puzzles in MatchCraft Match Three. Match pieces to collect rocks, break ice and handle lava or boulders. Complete the mining tasks needed to move Steve into the next part of the route.

pages.title: Domino
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guide a line of falling pieces toward its endpoint in Domino. Place the setup carefully so one toppled tile can reach the next without a break. Adjust around the obstacles on more difficult platforms to complete the chain.

pages.title: Crazy Goat Hunter
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Search forest terrain for targets in Crazy Goat Hunter. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse and reload when needed. Finish the current hunting assignment to unlock another weapon for later levels.

pages.title: Mr Wick Chapter One
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Steer a projectile toward enemies in Mr Wick Chapter One. Use the arrow keys to guide the bullet through the route and reach the target. Read each new arrangement before choosing how to get around its obstacles.

pages.title: Lucky Life
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description: Take a character through dangerous courses in Lucky Life. Move with the arrow keys and avoid saws, spikes, arrows and knives along the route. Reach each finish with as many stars as you can keep.

pages.title: Lovely Ant Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Search for clues and useful items in Lovely Ant Escape. Inspect the locations and solve the puzzles that control the way out. Follow each discovery to free the trapped ant and complete the escape.

pages.title: Stack Jump
pages.creator: loko8
pages.description: Jump onto moving blocks in Stack Jump. Time each landing to build another layer without being knocked off. Try the six progressively harder stages or keep raising the tower and your record in endless mode.

pages.title: Extreme Water Floating Bus
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive a coach over water in Extreme Water Floating Bus. Follow the floating route and manage turns as the vehicle travels across the surface. Complete the driving challenges while keeping the bus aligned with the next destination.

pages.title: Bottle Flip Pro
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Tap to flip a bottle onto furniture in Bottle Flip Pro. Judge the distance between shelves, tables and chairs before choosing a single or double jump. Keep the bottle landing on objects as you cross each room.

pages.title: Mountain Uphill Passenger Train Simulator
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Carry passengers over mountain railways in Mountain Uphill Passenger Train Simulator. Pick people up at stations and control the train's speed through sharp bends. Change camera views to check the route before delivering each group to its stop.

pages.title: Elephants Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six pictures to reconstruct in Elephants Puzzle. Select a piece count from sixteen to one hundred, then connect matching edges and details. Finish the image before trying a larger layout or another scene.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Infinite
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pop matching bubble groups in Bubble Shooter Infinite. Aim at clusters of three or more and use power-ups to reach awkward areas. Keep the hanging bubbles above the danger line to extend the round.

pages.title: Doggy Face Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Color eight pet portraits in Doggy Face Coloring. Choose among twenty-three shades and fill the outlined details quickly if you want a higher score. Save the picture after finishing the dog's face and surroundings.

pages.title: Kart Karting Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six kart-themed illustrations in Kart Karting Puzzle. Choose sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four or one hundred pieces and join the sections by matching edges and colors. Rebuild the character and vehicle in each scene.

pages.title: Candy Cane Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Swap festive treats into groups of three or more in Candy Cane Match 3. Keep producing matches before the meter at the side drops too low. Look for the next useful group as the holiday pieces move into place.

pages.title: Park the Beetle
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Steer vehicles into marked bays in Park the Beetle. Leave clearance around other cars and objects as you approach the space, since a collision loses the attempt. Work through the different parking layouts with careful turns.

pages.title: Space Blaze 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fight spacecraft and bosses in Space Blaze 2. Collect stars for additional ships and use the craft's weapons to survive the encounters ahead. Finish the initial campaign to open a more difficult Nightmare mode.

pages.title: Break The Gems
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Move a jewel into other target stones in Break The Gems. Use the arrow keys to line up contact and remove the pieces in the right order. Solve forty boards as the routes become harder to untangle.

pages.title: FZ Unlock Blox
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Slide obstacles aside to release the yellow piece in FZ Unlock Blox. Look at the empty spaces and work out which block must move first. Continue rearranging until the target has a clear route out.

pages.title: Shoot Up
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Take repeated shots on goal in Shoot Up. Aim and time the kick to get past the defense while avoiding wasted attempts. You can miss only three times, so use each result to judge the next shot.

pages.title: Twist
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Rotate through a narrow channel in Twist. Use the arrow keys to adjust the angle before the next barrier arrives. Keep the moving piece aligned with the available opening to avoid a collision.

pages.title: Halloween Memory
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Reveal pairs of identical pictures in Halloween Memory. Remember the location of cards that do not match and use that knowledge to find their partners. Clear the spooky board before time runs out.

pages.title: SeeSaw Ramp Car Balance Driving Challenge
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Balance a vehicle on a tilting ramp in SeeSaw Ramp Car Balance Driving Challenge. Move carefully to keep the platform level instead of sending the car over an end. Train alone or test your balance against another driver.

pages.title: Fidget Hand Spinner
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Set a toy rotating in Fidget Hand Spinner. Use the mouse to build a spin, watch the score and try another attempt when it slows. Collect coins and explore the different spinner designs available.

pages.title: American Cars Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Paint six vehicle drawings in American Cars Coloring Book. Choose among twenty-four colors and work quickly when aiming for a strong score. Save or print the finished image once the car and background are complete.

pages.title: Cheerful Glass
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fill an empty cup in Cheerful Glass. Work out how to send the water through the level's obstacles and reach the required amount. Make the glass happy by completing the fill without losing too much along the way.

pages.title: Cute Pony Care
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Look after an overworked farm animal in Cute Pony Care. Treat the pony's wounds, offer food to restore its energy and choose an outfit afterward. Complete the care activities before returning it to the day's work.

pages.title: Baby Doll House Cleaning
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Tidy the rooms in Baby Doll House Cleaning. Follow the task list to clean up the mess and place scattered items where they belong. Finish every part of the current room to complete its mission.

pages.title: Spacecraft II
pages.creator: Hack TheREALITY
pages.description: Pilot an armed craft in Spacecraft II. Maneuver through the battle area and use the futuristic weapons against approaching enemies. Stay clear of their attacks while looking for another firing position.

pages.title: EG Rise Up
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Move a shield above a rising balloon in EG Rise Up. Push obstacles aside before they drift into its path and keep checking the space farther up the screen. Protect the balloon long enough to reach a better height.

pages.title: Bounce Balls
pages.creator: mrseo88
pages.description: Drag a triangular ship beneath bouncing targets in Bounce Balls. Shoot the numbered balls while keeping them away from the craft. Use power-ups when available and keep clearing pieces to improve the leaderboard score.

pages.title: Flappy Color Birds
pages.creator: TopSoft UG
pages.description: Guide a bird through a barrier of its own color in Flappy Color Birds. Tap to control its height and line up with the matching section. Stay clear of the other colors as you keep the flight going.

pages.title: Geo Dash
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Time jumps through geometric traps in Geo Dash. Watch the route ahead and react before an obstacle reaches the character. Get through each difficult section without hitting the hazards blocking the course.

pages.title: Princess Style Vlog: OMG Wedding!
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Prepare Rapunzel and her bridesmaids in Princess Style Vlog: OMG Wedding! Choose wedding looks for Pocahontas and Cinderella alongside the bride, then coordinate the finishing accessories. Help the vlog's stars get ready for the ceremony.

pages.title: Aunt Mary Solitaire
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Sort a partially hidden tableau in Aunt Mary Solitaire. Build sequences to reveal more cards while working around the game's Yukon-style rules. Check how a moved stack changes the available plays before committing to the next transfer.

pages.title: Neon Pong
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Defend your end of the table in Neon Pong. Move the paddle with A and D or the mouse and send the ball past the opposing paddle. Stay ready for another rebound when your shot comes back.

pages.title: Baby Room Designer
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two expecting couples decorate in Baby Room Designer. Choose from furniture and accessories suggested for the nursery and compare how the pieces work together. Finish the room with a coordinated arrangement for the baby.

pages.title: Galaxy Shoes
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Decorate ordinary trainers in Galaxy Shoes. Apply color and glittery details to turn the plain footwear into a space-inspired design. Try different combinations before finishing the pair.

pages.title: The Spear Stickman
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Trade thrown weapons with opponents in The Spear Stickman. Adjust the angle and power to reach an enemy on another platform, then release the spear. Aim carefully while staying ahead of the next return shot.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Die Adventure
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Keep unusual creatures alive in Silly Ways To Die Adventure. React to the dangers presented by each stage and work out which action gets the character through. Continue the voyage by solving the next comic survival challenge.

pages.title: Monster Truck Forest Delivery
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Carry boxes along a woodland course in Monster Truck Forest Delivery. Control the truck over uneven surfaces and keep the load in its bed. Deliver more of the cargo to work toward a stronger star result.

pages.title: Halloween Princess Party
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Style three royals for a castle celebration in Halloween Princess Party. Choose costumes and unusual accessories to suit each character's disguise. Bring the looks together before the princesses arrive at the kingdom's party.
